headline: Mahesh Chandra Garg reports Goodluck India share acquisition
hook: Promoter stake adjustment at Goodluck India
summary: Promoter Mahesh Chandra Garg has filed a disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations regarding an acquisition of shares in Goodluck India. The filing pertains to an acquisition made under an exemption provided by Regulation 10 of the takeover code. Such filings are mandatory for promoters to report changes in their shareholding patterns to the exchange.
why_it_matters: Reflects internal promoter shareholding changes, usually neutral for retail investors.
